correctness.rationale: All positive integer orders n>=2 and matching deletions 0<=m<=n are handled. The initial-shore run distribution is exact, the two extra-peak events are exhaustive and mutually exclusive, and each conditional probability is derived by sampling without replacement. Their sum yields the complete generating function and affine mixture. A summably uniform expansion of the finite urn law gives the O(n^-2) total-variation remainder and explicit one-sixth coefficient. Independent all-permutation enumeration and a vertex-subset dynamic program verify small graph cases, with limitations stated.

value.rationale: A complete distributional structural identity across a natural perturbation family, not merely its degree-controlled mean, and a sharp one-sixth crossover in first-order geometric convergence are motivated by the dependence of random local maxima and exact recolouring times. The nonmonotone error coefficient and exact affine distribution are mathematically informative beyond finite table computations.
